13: 14: --- 15: 16: ## ✨ Features Overview 17: 18: ### 🔐 Authentication & Role Management 19: - **Flexible Credential Login**: Students can log in with their Student ID (normalized across string, numeric, and formatted inputs with dashes/spaces) or Email. Faculty can log in with their Faculty ID, initials (case-insensitive), or Email. 20: - **Segmented Role Toggles**: Dedicated Student and Faculty login tabs with strict cross-role enforcement (prevents student accounts from authenticating via the faculty tab and vice versa). 21: - **Onboarding Role Lockdown**: After initial signup, role identity is locked on the details setup screen, ensuring students cannot bypass section assignments or switch to faculty post-registration. 22: - **6-Tier Role System**: 23: 1. `Student` - View personalized section tasks, export tasks, take markdown notes, and sync personal Google Classroom assignments. 24: 2. `CR` (Class Representative) - Create, edit, and manage section tasks, deadlines, and group notices. 25: 3. `Faculty` - Comprehensive departmental oversight and coordinator capabilities. 28: 6. `Admin` - Complete platform administration, user management, account approvals, role assignments, UID lookups, and the **Admin Role Preview Mode** (simulate any role with a real-time floating indicator). 29: - **Faculty Self-Registration & Approvals**: Faculty self-register with pending status until approved by an Admin or Department Coordinator via the interactive Approvals modal. 30: 31: ### 📋 Task Management & Productivity 32: - **Personalized Task Feed**: Automatic task filtering based on Department, Semester, and Section Group (`A1+A2`, `B1+B2`, etc.). 33: - **Overdue Grace Period**: Retains tasks in the active feed for a 12-hour grace period after the deadline passes before archiving. 34: - **Desktop Single-Row Layout**: Coordinated action row for `Add Tasks`, `View Old`, and `Reset Tasks` on desktop screens. 35: - **Mobile-Responsive Task Actions & Filters**: 36: - Compact button labels on mobile (`Add`, `Old`, `Reset`). 37: - **UITS Event Raiders Syndication**: Live syndication of hackathons, contests, symposiums, and tech events from `ou1ts/events` RSS/JSON feeds with desktop sticky sidebar integration and mobile toggle view switchers. 42: - **Google Classroom Integration**: 43: - Unified course stream showing assignments, materials, and announcements with OAuth session persistence. 44: - 3-group status layout (**Assigned**, **Missing**, **Turned In / Graded**) with chronological upcoming deadline priority and "Past deadline" visual divider banners. 45: - Strict turn-in verification for automatic task completion. 46: - Decoupled Classroom sync briefing summaries and quick announcement/assignment posting for Faculty and CRs. 47: - **University & CR Notices**: Real-time section notices posted by CRs and department notices posted by Faculty, alongside a UCAM university notice viewer with inline PDF preview via a Vercel serverless backend. 48: 49: ### 📝 Notes & Productivity Tools 50: - **Rich Markdown Notes**: Personal note-taking module with auto-save, search, formatting tools, and temporary file hosting (Catbox.moe / Tmpfiles.org).

32: ### Description
33: 
34: b1t-Sched is a web-based academic task scheduler designed for university students. It provides a personalized dashboard with tasks, events, and resource links filtered by the student's department, semester, and section.
35: 
36: ### Key Features
37: 
38: - **Single-Page Application (SPA)** - Hash-based routing for seamless navigation
39: - **Firebase Authentication** - Secure email/password login system with email verification and password reset
40: - **User Profiles** - Student ID, department, semester, and section
41: - **Personalized Dashboard** - Content filtered by user's academic details
42: - **Task Management** - View pending assignments and exams with deadlines (or "No official Time limit"), with enhanced markdown support (**bold**, _italic_, fenced code blocks, inline code, links), HTML entity rendering (e.g., \*, ×), `<pre>` tag support for preserved formatting, clickable links, and collapsible descriptions (2-line truncation). "Set Deadline" is now the default option when adding tasks.
43: - **Task Completion** - Checkboxes to mark tasks complete, persistent per-user
44: - **Task Editing** - Users can edit their own tasks; admins can edit all tasks; Course is required field
45: - **Event Calendar** - Track upcoming academic events with enhanced markdown support (HTML entities, code blocks, `<pre>` tags), clickable links, collapsible descriptions (2-line truncation), and department scope badge (ALL/CSE/etc.)
46: - **Event Editing** - Admins can edit all events; CRs can edit/delete their own events
47: - **Resource Links** - Quick access to department-specific resources with built-in PDF viewer (desktop: Google Docs Viewer in modal; mobile: opens in new tab)
48: - **Google Classroom Integration** - View all assignments, announcements, and posted course materials from enrolled courses in a unified interface with OAuth authentication and session persistence (auto-refresh tokens & cached fallback mode). Features three view toggle tabs (**To-Do**, **Notices**, **Materials**), real-time assignment status badges (**Assigned** [Blue], **Missing** [Red], **Turned in** / **Turned in (Late)** [Green], and **Returned** / **Graded: X/Y** [Purple]), responsive mobile course view header (toggle buttons wrap cleanly to the 2nd line under the course title), default hiding of Archived Classrooms with an interactive toggle button, a unified pill-styled Sign Out button dynamically shown when logged in, seamless expired token recovery with a 1-click **Reconnect** banner (prevents popup flashes and blank screens), and a one-click **Sync to Tasks** feature for Admins/CRs to automatically add Classroom assignments to the main Tasks list (avoids duplicates).
49: - **Session Security** - Automatic logout after 1 hour of inactivity (unless "Stay logged in" is checked), with activity-based timer reset for enhanced security
50: - **Stay Logged In** - Optional "Trust this device" checkbox on login to persist session indefinitely on safe devices

# Implementation Plan: b1t-Sched Backlog Audit & Multi-Phase Roadmap

This plan maps every item from your task list (`20` down to `1`, including unnumbered sub-items) against the **current state of the codebase** (`v2.53.15`), separating what is **already implemented**, what requires **bug fixes or UI/permission work**, what involves **documentation cleanup**, and what requires **external infrastructure or clarification**.

> **Status**: Planning only — **no code or doc changes have been executed yet**.

---

## 1. Already Implemented / Resolved in Recent Versions

These items already exist in the current repository and do not need to be re-built unless you want behavioral adjustments:

| Item | Original Note | Current Implementation in Repo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **#20** | Classroom assignment state (submitted or not) & auto-check corresponding tasks complete | Implemented in `js/features/classroom.js` & `css/classroom.css` (v2.46.0, v2.51.x, v2.52.2): `studentSubmissions?userId=me` tracks `Assigned`, `Missing`, `Turned in`, and `Returned / Graded` badges (`.classroom-status-badge`), and `syncTurnedInAssignmentsToUserCompletions()` checks off matching synced tasks on refresh/reconnect. |
| **#16 (part)** | Faculty gets logged out on refresh; preview mode tasks as faculty did not show in pure faculty | Resolved in v2.53.14 (`js/core/app.js` `_isExplicitLoginAttempt`, `js/core/db.js` `DB.getFacultyTasks()`): background refreshes preserve Faculty sessions and `DB.getFacultyTasks()` includes tasks with `addedByRole === 'Faculty'` or null semester/section. |
| **#14 (part)** | Classroom caching | Implemented in `js/features/classroom.js` via `classroom_cached_json`, `CacheManager`, and persistent Reconnect footer for expired tokens. |
| **#11** | Work on note UI; upload `.sh` / auto-zip while uploading | Implemented in v2.39.0 (`js/features/notes.js`): `JSZip` automatically compresses unsupported extensions (e.g., `.sh`, `.exe`) into `.zip` blobs before uploading via Catbox.moe / Tmpfiles.org / File.io. |
| **#5** | Fix account deletion | Implemented in v2.52.0 (`js/core/app.js`, `js/core/db.js`): direct Firestore user deletion, `Remove Details` profile stripping fallback, and Firebase Auth console UID guidance. |
| **#2** | Colored fill/badge by task type on calendar | Implemented in `js/features/calendar-view.js` & `css/calendar.css`: tasks on calendar cells and weekly views render color-coded `.task-type-badge` indicators per task type (`assignment`, `exam`, `homework`, `project`, etc.). |

---

## 2. Phase A — Bug Fixes & Quick Wins (Code & Styling)

### Item #3: Web App Status Bar Is Green
- **Root Cause**: [index.html](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/index.html#L15) sets `<meta name="theme-color" content="#4CAF50">` (green), overriding the maroon `#660000` theme color in [manifest.json](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/manifest.json#L8).
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Update `<meta name="theme-color" content="#660000">` in `index.html`.
  - Synchronize `meta[name="theme-color"]` dynamically in `js/core/app.js` / `js/features/profile.js` when switching between Light (`#660000`), Dark (`#262626`), and Gray (`#0b0a10`) themes, and align `defaultConfig.theme_color` in `js/pwa/manifest-generator.js`.

### Items #7 & #8: App Icon Not Appearing in Desktop Web App
- **Root Cause**: [manifest.json](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/manifest.json#L10-L22) only provides `"/b1t-sched.webp"` (`type: "image/webp"`), which desktop Chromium/Edge/Windows PWA installers often fail to convert into desktop/taskbar icons; meanwhile, [manifest-generator.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/pwa/manifest-generator.js#L18-L29) references nonexistent `/images/icon-192x192.png` and `/images/icon-512x512.png`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Generate standard PNG icons (`images/icon-192x192.png`, `images/icon-512x512.png`, plus `apple-touch-icon.png` 180×180) from `b1t-sched.webp` / `Social-Preview.webp`.
  - Register PNG icons in `manifest.json` (`purpose: "any"` and `"maskable"` entries) and add `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/images/icon-192x192.png">` and PNG `<link rel="icon">` tags in `index.html`, caching them in `sw.js`.

### Item #19 (Sub-item 3): Homescreen Back Button Returns to Logged-Out Login Screen
- **Root Cause**: [routing.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/core/routing.js#L30-L46) has no authentication guard inside `handleRoute()`, and login navigation uses `window.location.hash = '#/dashboard'` (leaving `''` login route in browser history). Pressing Back from `#/dashboard` opens `#login-view`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Add an auth guard in `Router.handleRoute()`: if user is authenticated with a completed profile and navigates to `''` (login) or `#/set-details` (when profile already exists), redirect via `history.replaceState` to `#/dashboard`.
  - When logging in (`App.handleAuthenticatedUser`), replace the login history entry (`history.replaceState(null, '', '#/dashboard')`) and handle `popstate` cleanly so pressing Back on the home screen stays on the dashboard or exits cleanly without showing a logged-out login form.
  - Guard reverse redirects (unauthenticated users trying to navigate forward into `#/dashboard`, `#/profile-settings`, `#/user-management`).

### Item #19 (Sub-item 1): Mobile View Missing Notice Cooldown Updates
- **Root Cause**: In [notice.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/features/notice.js#L240-L249) and [index.html](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/index.html#L868), `#refresh-notices-btn-mobile` is hidden until `renderAllNotices()` runs, shows no live cooldown timer state on the button itself, and `UI.showToast` / error banners can be missed behind the mobile notice drawer (`z-index: var(--z-modal)`).
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Add a shared cooldown countdown ticker (`startRefreshCooldownTimer()`) in `NoticeViewer` that disables both `#refresh-notices-btn-mobile` and `#refresh-notices-btn-desktop` during the 60s window and renders remaining seconds directly on the button (`Wait 45s`) plus an inline status badge inside both desktop and mobile notice panels.
  - Ensure `#toast-container` sits above sidebars/modals (`z-index > 12000`) so cooldown toasts are visible on mobile.

### Item #16 (Sub-item 1): 1-Line Caption Truncation in Classroom Window/Sidebar
- **Root Cause**: [css/classroom.css](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/css/classroom.css#L573-L581) applies `white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;` to `.item-snippet`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Replace single-line `white-space: nowrap` on `.item-snippet` with multi-line wrapping (`white-space: normal; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;`) when collapsed and full unconstrained display when `.classroom-item.expanded` is active.

### Item #6 (Sub-item 3): Timeline View Close Button Buggy on Mobile
- **Root Cause**: [css/timeline.css](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS]\b1t-Sched\css\timeline.css#L1-L8) shifts `#close-timeline-modal:hover` via `padding: 0 5px 2px 5px; margin-right: -5px;`, causing touch-tap jitter/misalignment on mobile alongside `document.body.style.zoom` interactions in `timeline-ui.js`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Remove layout-shifting `padding`/`margin-right` hover rules on `#close-timeline-modal` and enforce a fixed `36px × 36px` (desktop) / `40px × 40px` (mobile) touch target with centered icon alignment and proper `flex-shrink: 0` in `.modal-header`.

### Item #6 (Sub-item 2): Note Link Download Only Opens in New Tab
- **Root Cause**: [notes.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/features/notes.js#L181-L215) and [utils.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/core/utils.js#L216-L221) rely on `<a href="..." download>`, which browsers ignore for cross-origin hosts (`files.catbox.moe`, `tmpfiles.org`, `file.io`).
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Intercept clicks on uploaded file links inside `#note-preview-content` (and task/note description file links) to attempt a CORS `fetch(url) -> res.blob() -> URL.createObjectURL(blob)` download with extracted filename, gracefully falling back to opening in a new tab + helper banner if the host blocks CORS.

### Items #1 & #15: Mobile Add-Task Screen & Form Submissions Overflow / Zoom
- **Root Cause**: `App.adjustMobileZoom()` in [app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js#L352-L358) sets `document.body.style.zoom = '95%'`, while inputs with `font-size < 16px` trigger iOS Safari auto-zoom on focus, and `#add-task-modal`, `#edit-task-modal`, `#add-event-modal`, `#add-cr-notice-modal` lack strict viewport locking (`100dvh`) and compact spacing for small screens.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Enforce `font-size: 16px` on form inputs/selects/textareas under `@media (max-width: 768px)` to prevent browser auto-zoom on focus.
  - Lock `#add-task-modal` / `#edit-task-modal` / form modals to `100dvh` full-screen on mobile with `overscroll-behavior: none` on the backdrop and non-scrolling outer container (keeping only internal `.modal-body` scrollable if needed, or tightening form spacing/grid rows so the entire Add Task form fits within one mobile viewport without scrolling).
  - Compact `#add-event-modal`, `#add-cr-notice-modal`, `#signup-form`, and `#set-details-form` padding/margins on `<= 480px` to eliminate horizontal/vertical overflow.

---

## 3. Phase B — Role, Feature & UX Enhancements

### Item #17: DptCoor Should Be Able to Modify Other Faculty Tasks
- **Current Gap**:
  - [firestore.rules](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/firestore.rules#L88-L99) only permits `isAdmin()` or `resource.data.addedBy == request.auth.uid` for task updates/deletes.
  - [ui.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/core/ui.js#L454-L462) and [app.js](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/js/core/app.js#L1011) check `canEdit = isAdmin || task.addedBy === userId`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Update `firestore.rules` `/tasks/{taskId}` `update` and `delete` rules to allow `isDptCoor()` when `resource.data.department == getUserDepartment()` and the task is a faculty task (e.g., `resource.data.addedByRole == 'Faculty'` or `resource.data.semester == null`).
  - Update `UI.renderTaskCard()` and `App.openEditTaskModal()` / `App.handleDeleteTask()` so `isDptCoor` (when matching department and faculty task) sees Edit and Delete controls on faculty tasks in their department.

### Item #19 (Sub-item 2): Hidden Option to Force-Complete Tasks Without Deadline
- **Current State**: Tasks without a deadline (`deadline === null`) currently stay in Pending Tasks indefinitely (`resetOldTasks()` skips them, though individual checkboxes work).
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Add a discreet/hidden power-user trigger (e.g., Shift+click or long-press on the **Reset** button, or a subtle secondary option inside a confirmation modal / Profile Settings advanced section) to **"Force-Complete / Archive No-Deadline Tasks"** (either marking all no-deadline active tasks as completed for the user, or archiving/deleting selected old no-deadline tasks for Admin/CR/Faculty). *(We will confirm exact behavior — per-user completion vs Admin/CR deletion — before implementing.)*

### Item #16 (Sub-item 2): Forgot Password Hint vs Always Visible
- **Current State**: [index.html](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/index.html#L218-L222) hides `#forgot-password-container` until a failed login attempt (`App.handleLogin` adds `.visible`).
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Keep `#forgot-password-link` hidden until wrong password entry **and** display a permanent subtle hint below the password/login button (`"Forgot your password? A reset link will appear after an incorrect password attempt."`), **or** make the Forgot Password link always visible based on your preference before execution.

### Item #18: Visitor Mode (Read-Only Guest Access)
- **Current Gap**: All `tasks`, `events`, and `cr_notices` queries in [firestore.rules](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/firestore.rules#L83-L116) require `isSignedIn()`, and `App` forces unauthenticated users to `login-view`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Add a **"Continue as Visitor"** button on `#login-view` opening a Department / Semester / Section picker (using existing `Utils` metadata dropdowns).
  - Use Firebase Anonymous Auth (`firebase.auth().signInAnonymously()`) or read-only visitor rules in `firestore.rules` (excluding private user collections/notes/completions).
  - Run `App` in `isVisitor = true` mode: show a top **"Visitor Mode (Read-Only) — Sign In"** banner, disable task completion checkboxes, Notes, Classroom OAuth, Profile Settings, and all Add/Edit/Delete controls.

### Item #14 (Sub-items 3 & 4): Notifications on Mobile, CR Notice Notifications & Slow Loading
- **Notifications (`js/notifications/notification-manager.js`, `js/core/firestore-listener-manager.js`, `sw.js`)**:
  - Fix `NotificationManager` check (`navigator.serviceWorker.controller` can be `null` right after SW registration; use `await navigator.serviceWorker.ready` whenever `ServiceWorkerRegistration.showNotification` is available).
  - Verify `FirestoreListenerManager.listenForNewNotices` does not fail silently if a composite index on `cr_notices (department, semester, section, timestamp)` is missing (remove `.orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')` or deploy composite index in `firestore.indexes.json`, matching `cr-notice.js` Department notices).
  - Document OS/PWA limitation: real-time `onSnapshot` only delivers notifications while the app/PWA is open in foreground; true closed-app push requires Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) + a Cloud Function trigger.
- **Website Load Performance**:
  - Defer heavy third-party libraries (`html2pdf.js`, `jszip`, `chart.js`) so they lazy-load only when Notes/Export/Timeline are opened rather than blocking initial page load.
  - Preload critical cached dashboard data immediately from `localStorage` before Firebase round-trips finish.

### Item #6 (Sub-item 1): Uni Notice Caching / Admin Refresh Persistence
- **Current State**: `NoticeViewer` fetches from `https://b1t-acad-backend.vercel.app/api/notices` (Vercel Blob storage) and caches locally for 7 days.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Mirror the latest fetched University Notice list in a shared Firestore document (e.g., `metadata/uni_notices`) whenever refreshed so every client loads instantaneously from Firestore/localStorage without cold-start delays on the Vercel serverless backend.

### Items #4 & #9: Desktop Login Window & Screen Resolution Scaling
- **Desktop Login Window (`#4`)**: Refine `#login-view` desktop layout (`.auth-hero-wrapper`, `.auth-card`, `.login-footer-section`) into a clean centered/two-column desktop viewport without excessive vertical scrolling.
- **Resolution Scaling (`#9`)**: Audit `App.adjustMobileZoom()` (`document.body.style.zoom = '95%'`, which is non-standard in Firefox and causes coordinate offsets in modals/charts) and replace fragile `zoom` hacks with clean CSS fluid spacing/font-size breakpoints across `360px`, `480px`, `768px`, `1024px`, `1366px`, and `1920px+`.

---

## 4. Phase C — Documentation Cleanup & References

### Item #12: Organize `doc/` Folder (Except `DOCUMENTATION.md`)
- **Current State**: `doc/` currently has fragmented tool folders (`antigravity_01/`, `kiro_01/`, `issue-fixes/`, `summaries/`, `walkthrough/`, `prompts/`, `notes/`, `plan/`, `design-2.0/`, `firebaseQueries/`, plus loose `.md`/`.js`/`.txt` files at `doc/` root).
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Keep `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md` at `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md` and preserve `doc/prompts/` (required by `AGENTS.md`).
  - Reorganize remaining docs under clean categorical folders:
    - `doc/features/` (feature specs & implementation guides: Calendar, Classroom, Notices, Notes, Notifications, Events RSS, Timeline, Role Hierarchy)
    - `doc/architecture/` (Firebase setup, Firestore rules/indexes, PWA architecture, Design & Redesign plans)
    - `doc/limitations-and-deprecated/` (known limitations, reverted implementations such as Firebase Storage migration for temporary note uploads due to bucket/CORS constraints)

- **Planned Changes**:
  - Generate standard PNG icons (`images/icon-192x192.png`, `images/icon-512x512.png`, plus `apple-touch-icon.png` 180×180) from `b1t-sched.webp` / `Social-Preview.webp`.
  - Register PNG icons in `manifest.json` (`purpose: "any"` and `"maskable"` entries) and add `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/images/icon-192x192.png">` and PNG `<link rel="icon">` tags in `index.html`, caching them in `sw.js`.

Pressing Back from `#/dashboard` opens `#login-view`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Add an auth guard in `Router.handleRoute()`: if user is authenticated with a completed profile and navigates to `''` (login) or `#/set-details` (when profile already exists), redirect via `history.replaceState` to `#/dashboard`.
  - When logging in (`App.handleAuthenticatedUser`), replace the login history entry (`history.replaceState(null, '', '#/dashboard')`) and handle `popstate` cleanly so pressing Back on the home screen stays on the dashboard or exits cleanly without showing a logged-out login form.
  - Guard reverse redirects (unauthenticated users trying to navigate forward into `#/dashboard`, `#/profile-settings`, `#/user-management`).

### Item #19 (Sub-item 1): Mobile View Missing Notice Cooldown Updates

  - Add a shared cooldown countdown ticker (`startRefreshCooldownTimer()`) in `NoticeViewer` that disables both `#refresh-notices-btn-mobile` and `#refresh-notices-btn-desktop` during the 60s window and renders remaining seconds directly on the button (`Wait 45s`) plus an inline status badge inside both desktop and mobile notice panels.

- **Root Cause**: [css/classroom.css](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/css/classroom.css#L573-L581) applies `white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;` to `.item-snippet`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Replace single-line `white-space: nowrap` on `.item-snippet` with multi-line wrapping (`white-space: normal; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;`) when collapsed and full unconstrained display when `.classroom-item.expanded` is active.

- **Root Cause**: [css/timeline.css](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/css/timeline.css#L1-L8) shifts `#close-timeline-modal:hover` via `padding: 0 5px 2px 5px; margin-right: -5px;`, causing touch-tap jitter/misalignment on mobile alongside `document.body.style.zoom` interactions in `timeline-ui.js`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Remove layout-shifting `padding`/`margin-right` hover rules on `#close-timeline-modal` and enforce a fixed `36px × 36px` (desktop) / `40px × 40px` (mobile) touch target with centered icon alignment and proper `flex-shrink: 0` in `.modal-header`.

- **Notifications (`js/notifications/notification-manager.js`, `js/core/firestore-listener-manager.js`, `sw.js`)**:

  - Add a discreet/hidden power-user trigger (e.g., Shift+click or long-press on the **Reset** button, or a subtle secondary option inside a confirmation modal / Profile Settings advanced section) to **"Force-Complete / Archive No-Deadline Tasks"** (either marking all no-deadline active tasks as completed for the user, or archiving/deleting selected old no-deadline tasks for Admin/CR/Faculty). *(We will confirm exact behavior — per-user completion vs Admin/CR deletion — before implementing.)*

### Item #16 (Sub-item 2): Forgot Password Hint vs Always Visible
- **Current State**: [index.html](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/index.html#L218-L222) hides `#forgot-password-container` until a failed login attempt (`App.handleLogin` adds `.visible`).
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Keep `#forgot-password-link` hidden until wrong password entry **and** display a permanent subtle hint below the password/login button (`"Forgot your password? A reset link will appear after an incorrect password attempt."`), **or** make the Forgot Password link always visible based on your preference before execution.

### Item #18: Visitor Mode (Read-Only Guest Access)
- **Current Gap**: All `tasks`, `events`, and `cr_notices` queries in [firestore.rules](file:///d:/GitHub/%5BoU1TS%5D/b1t-Sched/firestore.rules#L83-L116) require `isSignedIn()`, and `App` forces unauthenticated users to `login-view`.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Add a **"Continue as Visitor"** button on `#login-view` opening a Department / Semester / Section picker (using existing `Utils` metadata dropdowns).
  - Use Firebase Anonymous Auth (`firebase.auth().signInAnonymously()`) or read-only visitor rules in `firestore.rules` (excluding private user collections/notes/completions).
  - Run `App` in `isVisitor = true` mode: show a top **"Visitor Mode (Read-Only) — Sign In"** banner, disable task completion checkboxes, Notes, Classroom OAuth, Profile Settings, and all Add/Edit/Delete controls.

### Item #14 (Sub-items 3 & 4): Notifications on Mobile, CR Notice Notifications & Slow Loading
- **Notifications (`js/notifications/notification-manager.js`, `js/core/firestore-listener-manager.js`, `sw.js`)**:
  - Fix `NotificationManager` check (`navigator.serviceWorker.controller` can be `null` right after SW registration; use `await navigator.serviceWorker.ready` whenever `ServiceWorkerRegistration.showNotification` is available).
  - Verify `FirestoreListenerManager.listenForNewNotices` does not fail silently if a composite index on `cr_notices (department, semester, section, timestamp)` is missing (remove `.orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')` or deploy composite index in `firestore.indexes.json`, matching `cr-notice.js` Department notices).
  - Document OS/PWA limitation: real-time `onSnapshot` only delivers notifications while the app/PWA is open in foreground; true closed-app push requires Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) + a Cloud Function trigger.
- **Website Load Performance**:
  - Defer heavy third-party libraries (`html2pdf.js`, `jszip`, `chart.js`) so they lazy-load only when Notes/Export/Timeline are opened rather than blocking initial page load.
  - Preload critical cached dashboard data immediately from `localStorage` before Firebase round-trips finish.

### Item #6 (Sub-item 1): Uni Notice Caching / Admin Refresh Persistence
- **Current State**: `NoticeViewer` fetches from `https://b1t-acad-backend.vercel.app/api/notices` (Vercel Blob storage) and caches locally for 7 days.
- **Planned Changes**:
  - Mirror the latest fetched University Notice list in a shared Firestore document (e.g., `metadata/uni_notices`) whenever refreshed so every client loads instantaneously from Firestore/localStorage without cold-start delays on the Vercel serverless backend.

### Items #4 & #9: Desktop Login Window & Screen Resolution Scaling
- **Desktop Login Window (`#4`)**: Refine `#login-view` desktop layout (`.auth-hero-wrapper`, `.auth-card`, `.login-footer-section`) into a clean centered/two-column desktop viewport without excessive vertical scrolling.
- **Resolution Scaling (`#9`)**: Audit `App.adjustMobileZoom()` (`document.body.style.zoom = '95%'`, which is non-standard in Firefox and causes coordinate offsets in modals/charts) and replace fragile `zoom` hacks with clean CSS fluid spacing/font-size breakpoints across `360px`, `480px`, `768px`, `1024px`, `1366px`, and `1920px+`.

- **Current State**: `doc/` currently has fragmented tool folders (`antigravity_01/`, `kiro_01/`, `issue-fixes/`, `summaries/`, `walkthrough/`, `prompts/`, `notes/`, `plan/`, `design-2.0/`, `firebaseQueries/`, plus loose `.md`/`.js`/`.txt` files at `doc/` root).

Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationCore, WindowsBase
$icoPath = "d:\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched\Social-Preview.ico"
$stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($icoPath)
$decoder = New-Object System.Windows.Media.Imaging.IconBitmapDecoder($stream, [System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCreateOptions]::None, [System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCacheOption]::None)

Write-Host "Total frames: $($decoder.Frames.Count)"
$targetSizes = @(192, 512, 180)
$outDir = "d:\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched\images\icons"
if (-not (Test-Path $outDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir -Force }

# Find largest frame
$largestFrame = $decoder.Frames | Sort-Object PixelWidth -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
Write-Host "Largest frame: $($largestFrame.PixelWidth)x$($largestFrame.PixelHeight)"

foreach ($sz in $targetSizes) {
    $outPath = Join-Path $outDir "icon-${sz}x${sz}.png"
    if ($sz -eq 180) { $outPath = Join-Path $outDir "apple-touch-icon.png" }
    
    # Scale from largest frame
    $scaleTransform = New-Object System.Windows.Media.ScaleTransform(
        ($sz / $largestFrame.PixelWidth),
        ($sz / $largestFrame.PixelHeight)
    )
    $scaled = New-Object System.Windows.Media.Imaging.TransformedBitmap($largestFrame, $scaleTransform)
    
    $encoder = New-Object System.Windows.Media.Imaging.PngBitmapEncoder()
    $encoder.Frames.Add([System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapFrame]::Create($scaled))
    $outStream = [System.IO.File]::Create($outPath)
    $encoder.Save($outStream)
    $outStream.Close()
    Write-Host "Saved $outPath"
}
$stream.Close()

# b1t-Sched - Documentation Directory Index

This directory contains the complete technical, architectural, feature, and historical documentation for **b1t-Sched (Academic Task Scheduler)**.

---

## 1. Primary Documentation
- **[DOCUMENTATION.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/DOCUMENTATION.md)**: The authoritative, comprehensive reference manual for the application. Covers system architecture, technology stack, module structure, Firestore data models, API methods, responsive styling, design inspirations, and full version history.

---

## 2. Features Documentation
- **[ADMIN_FEATURES.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/ADMIN_FEATURES.md)**: Guide to Administrator and Department Coordinator tools, including user role toggling (Admin, DptCoor, Faculty, CR, Student, Blocked), Admin Role Preview mode, and bulk semester promotions.
- **[rss-events-integration/](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/rss-events-integration/)**: Specifications for integrating university-wide events and the external UITS Event Raiders syndication feed.
- **[firebaseQueries/](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/firebaseQueries/)**: Firestore querying patterns, indexing requirements, and performance optimizations.

---

## 3. Architecture & Setup
- **[QUICKSTART.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/QUICKSTART.md)**: Quick start guide for running b1t-Sched locally with Live Server or static hosting.
- **[FIREBASE_SETUP.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/FIREBASE_SETUP.md)**: Firebase project configuration, API keys, and environment initialization.
- **[FIREBASE_DATABASE_SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/FIREBASE_DATABASE_SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md)**: Firestore security rules, collection schemas, and indexes.
- **[FIRESTORE_TASK_CHANGES.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/FIRESTORE_TASK_CHANGES.md)**: Evolution of task document schema, completion maps, and role permissions.
- **[REDESIGN_PLAN.md](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/REDESIGN_PLAN.md)**: Architectural plan for the modular 2.0 rewrite.

---

## 4. Reverted Implementations & Known Limitations
- **Firebase Storage Bucket Uploads (Reverted)**:
  - *Context*: Notes originally attempted to upload attachments to Firebase Cloud Storage (`uploadToFirebaseStorage`).
  - *Reason for Reversion*: Strict free-tier quota limits (5 GB total storage, 1 GB/day bandwidth) and CORS configuration overhead.
  - *Current Solution*: Multi-provider fallback pipeline (`Catbox.moe` primary with 200 MB limit, `Tmpfiles.org` secondary) combined with client-side blob downloads.
- **Mobile Web Notification API Restriction (Known Limitation)**:
  - *Context*: Direct `new Notification(...)` calls fail with an `Illegal constructor` error on mobile operating systems (Android Chrome, iOS Safari).
  - *Current Solution*: Priority resolution via Service Worker (`navigator.serviceWorker.ready -> registration.showNotification`).
- **Device Viewport Auto-Zoom (Known Limitation)**:
  - *Context*: Android and iOS browsers trigger aggressive zoom-in when focusing `<input>` elements with font sizes below `16px`.
  - *Current Solution*: Modal forms enforce `font-size: 16px !important` on mobile, `100dvh` modal viewport clamping, and responsive CSS scaling.

---

## 5. Serial Prompts, Plans & Walkthroughs (AGENTS.md Archives)
All prompt sessions, implementation plans, and post-execution walkthroughs are systematically recorded in **[`doc/prompts/`](file:///d:/GitHub/[oU1TS]/b1t-Sched/doc/prompts/)**:
- **Session 36**: Classroom Shortcut FAB, Navbar GitHub Button, Mobile Footer Icons & Backlog Audit.
- **Session 35**: Classroom Sync, Modular Architecture, Theming & Authentication.
- **Session 34**: Firebase Task ID, Admin Role Preview Mode, Approvals & Department Notices.
- **Sessions 1-33**: Historical feature evolutions and bug fixes.

# Walkthrough - Visitor Mode, DptCoor Permissions, Task Reset & UI Polish

## Overview
This walkthrough covers the execution of the user-approved backlog plan across the application, addressing visitor preview mode with client-side only mock data, Department Coordinator permissions to manage faculty tasks, Admin/CR cleanup of tasks without deadlines along with semester auto-pruning, a 2-minute idle timer for password recovery, mobile notification reliability, university notice Firestore caching, desktop login window styling, and comprehensive documentation organization.

---

## Changes Implemented

### 1. Visitor Mode (Client-Side Static Mock Data)
- **Zero Firebase Dependency**: Created `js/features/visitor-data.js` containing rich mock tasks, events, notices, and profile data (`role: 'Visitor'`).
- **Login View Integration**: Added `<button id="visitor-mode-btn">` on `#login-view` in `index.html`.
- **Top Floating Banner**: Added `#visitor-preview-banner` displaying `"Visitor Mode (Preview)"` with an exit/sign-in action.
- **State & Guarding**: In `js/core/app.js`, implemented `startVisitorMode()` and `exitVisitorMode()`. Guarded `loadDashboardData()`, `handleAddTask()`, `openEditTaskModal()`, `handleDeleteTask()`, and `handleResetTasks()`.
- **Interactive Completions**: In `handleTaskCompletion()`, allowed in-memory checkbox toggling without firing backend writes.
- **Profile Modal**: In `js/features/profile.js`, displayed `"Visitor Guest"` and `"Visitor"` role badges, while disabling save operations.

### 2. Department Coordinator Permissions
- **Security Rules**: In `firestore.rules`, updated `match /tasks/{taskId}` update and delete rules to allow `(isDptCoor() && resource.data.department == getUserDepartment())`.
- **Action Buttons**: In `js/core/ui.js`, updated `renderTasks()`, `renderTaskCard()`, and `renderOldTasks()` to accept `isDptCoor` and `userDepartment`, enabling edit and delete buttons on faculty tasks within the same department.
- **Controllers**: In `js/core/app.js`, updated `openEditTaskModal()` and `handleDeleteTask()` to allow Department Coordinators to modify or delete faculty tasks in their department.

### 3. Admin & CR Cleanup of No-Deadline Tasks & Semester Auto-Pruning
- **Reset Logic**: In `js/core/db.js` (`DB.resetOldTasks`), removed the unconditional skip of tasks with no deadlines. Added support for `includeNoDeadline` and automatic deletion of no-deadline tasks older than one semester (180 days).
- **Prompting**: In `js/core/app.js` (`handleResetTasks`), added confirmation prompts allowing Admin and CR to choose whether to delete no-deadline tasks alongside expired deadline tasks.

### 4. Forgot Password 2-Minute Inactivity Trigger
- **Inactivity Timer**: In `js/core/app.js`, implemented `startForgotPasswordIdleTimer()` and `clearForgotPasswordIdleTimer()` with a 120-second threshold.
- **Form Activity Reset**: Reset the timer on `login-form` input events, clearing it on login submission or view changes.
- **Failed Attempt Visibility**: Kept immediate visibility on invalid password entry.

### 5. Mobile Notification Service Worker Ready Priority
- **Mobile Constructor Fix**: In `js/notifications/notification-manager.js`, updated `showTaskNotification()`, `showEventNotification()`, and `showNoticeNotification()` to check `'serviceWorker' in navigator` and await `navigator.serviceWorker.ready` directly, resolving `TypeError: Illegal constructor` exceptions thrown by mobile browsers when calling `new Notification(...)`.
- **Browser Support**: Enhanced `isSupported()` to recognize PushManager capabilities.

### 6. University Notices Firestore Metadata Caching
- **Instant Loading**: In `js/features/notice.js`, added pre-fetch checks against Firestore document `metadata/uni_notices`, enabling instant loading on student devices without waiting for backend cold starts.
- **Admin Mirroring**: Whenever an Admin refreshes notices, the top 50 notices are automatically mirrored to `metadata/uni_notices`.

### 7. Desktop Login Window Styling & Resolution Scaling
- **Desktop Card Styling**: In `css/main.css`, wrapped `.auth-card` on desktop screens (`min-width: 992px`) with an elevated container, border, backdrop shadow, and responsive padding.
- **Resolution Scaling**: In `js/core/app.js`, refined `adjustMobileZoom()` to set `--app-scale` dynamically across 360px, 480px, 768px, and desktop displays.

### 8. Documentation Reorganization & References
- **Taxonomy Index**: Created `doc/README.md` cataloging features, setup guides, limitations, and prompt archives.
- **References & Libraries**: In `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md` Section 17, documented inspirations from ClickUp, Google Calendar, GitHub, and analytical bar charts, alongside an exhaustive table of client libraries and a record of the reverted Firebase Storage bucket implementation.

### 9. Version Synchronization
- Updated cache version to `v2.53.16` in `sw.js` and registered `visitor-data.js` in static cache assets.
- Synchronized `changes.json` under `v2.53.0 to v2.53.16`.
- Synchronized `README.md` and `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md` under `## Version History`.

---

## Verification Results
- **Node.js Syntax Checks**: All modified JavaScript files (`app.js`, `ui.js`, `db.js`, `notice.js`, `profile.js`, `visitor-data.js`, `notification-manager.js`, `sw.js`) passed `node --check` with exit code 0.
- **JSON Parser Validation**: `changes.json` validated cleanly via `JSON.parse` with exit code 0.
- **Clean Workspace**: All changes tracked and verified.

1: # Repository Rules & Guidelines
2: 
3: ## 1. Changelog & History Maintenance
4: - **Automatic History Updates**: Whenever adding new features, fixing bugs, refactoring components, or altering UI/styles in this codebase, always document the changes in doc/DOCUMENTATION.md (under `## Version History`), changes.json, sw.js#L5-5 (const CACHE_VERSION), and README.md (keeping version, features, and roadmap checklist synchronized with the current release state).
5: - **Placement & Summaries in Documentation**:
6:   - In `doc/DOCUMENTATION.md`, record updates exclusively under `## Version History` as concise, high-level summaries (never at the very top of the file before the Table of Contents).
7:   - Detailed release notes and comprehensive per-change descriptions are maintained in `changes.json` (which powers the in-app changelog modal) and companion walkthrough files in `doc/prompts/`.
8: - **Version Ranges**: Consolidate patch updates into active minor version ranges (e.g., `v2.53.0 to v2.53.8`) in `changes.json` instead of fragmenting each patch into a separate standalone entry.
9: 
10: 
11: ## 2. Mandatory Prompt, Plan & Walkthrough Archiving
12: - **Target Location & Serial Session Folders**:
13:   - All conversation, prompt, plan, and walkthrough records reside inside [`doc/prompts/`](doc/prompts) in dedicated serial folders named with an incrementing major integer prefix:
14:     `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/` (e.g., `doc/prompts/36. Schedule Export Update/`).
15:   - **Determining `<N>`**: Inspect `doc/prompts/` to find the highest existing major integer prefix across both existing session folders and legacy flat `<N>. ...md` files, and assign `N = N_max + 1` for a new conversation session.
16:   - **Session Continuity**: Always update **the same session folder** (`doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/`) on each turn or when resuming an existing conversation; do NOT create a new major folder `<N+1>` per turn.
17: - **Required Files Inside `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/`**:
18:   1. **`transcript_full.jsonl`**: An exact, unmodified UTF-8 copy of `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl`. Never truncate, edit, or reformat lines in `transcript_full.jsonl`.
19:   2. **`conversation.md`**: A verbatim Markdown rendering generated directly from `transcript_full.jsonl`, including every step without summarizing or omitting content: metadata (`Conversation ID`, `Session Folder`, and `Continued From` if applicable), all `USER_INPUT.content`, all `PLANNER_RESPONSE.thinking` verbatim, all `PLANNER_RESPONSE.tool_calls` and tool/system outputs (`GENERIC` / `SYSTEM_MESSAGE`), and all `PLANNER_RESPONSE.content` verbatim.
20:   3. **`summary.md` (Conversation Summary Markdown)**: Maintained alongside `transcript_full.jsonl` and `conversation.md` in the same folder, preserving the frontmatter tags comment block at the top and summarizing session metadata, user goals, key technical decisions, files modified, verification results, and outcomes.
21:   4. **Companion Plans & Walkthroughs (Fractional Suffixes Reserved for Plans & Walkthroughs Only)**: Stored in the same `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/` folder:
22:      - Implementation plan: `<N>.1 Implementation Plan - <Plan Title>.md` (dual-write whenever creating/updating `implementation_plan.md` before user review)
23:      - Walkthrough document: `<N>.2 Walkthrough - <Title>.md` (dual-write whenever creating/updating `walkthrough.md` upon completion)
24:      - Subsequent plans/walkthroughs in the same session: `<N>.3 Implementation Plan - ...`, `<N>.4 Walkthrough - ...`, etc.
25: - **Update Cadence (Keeping the Archive Current)**:
26:   - Because the runtime writes a turn's final `PLANNER_RESPONSE` (final `thinking` and `content`) to `transcript_full.jsonl` after the turn finishes:
27:     1. **At the start of each turn (or when continuing from a prior `<conversation-id>`):** Copy `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` to `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/transcript_full.jsonl` and regenerate `conversation.md` so the previous turn's finalized `thinking` and `content` are captured verbatim (and sync the prior conversation's folder if continuing).
28:     2. **Before sending each new final response:** Re-copy `transcript_full.jsonl`, regenerate `conversation.md` to capture all completed steps of the current turn, append the exact final response under `## Pending Final Response (Pre-Commit)` (noting it will be replaced verbatim from `transcript_full.jsonl` on the next sync), and create or update `summary.md` in the same folder.
29: 
30: ## 3. Code Quality & Styling Standards

- **Firebase Storage Bucket Uploads (Reverted)**:
  - *Context*: Notes originally attempted to upload attachments to Firebase Cloud Storage (`uploadToFirebaseStorage`).

  - *Current Solution*: Multi-provider fallback pipeline (`Catbox.moe` primary with 200 MB limit, `Tmpfiles.org` secondary) combined with client-side blob downloads.
- **Mobile Web Notification API Restriction (Known Limitation)**:
  - *Context*: Direct `new Notification(...)` calls fail with an `Illegal constructor` error on mobile operating systems (Android Chrome, iOS Safari).

- **Device Viewport Auto-Zoom (Known Limitation)**:
  - *Context*: Android and iOS browsers trigger aggressive zoom-in when focusing `<input>` elements with font sizes below `16px`.
  - *Current Solution*: Modal forms enforce `font-size: 16px !important` on mobile, `100dvh` modal viewport clamping, and responsive CSS scaling.

# Chat Conversation - 31. Offline Banner Dedicated Layout Space and Content Push Down

Note: _This is a comprehensive record of the pair programming session covering the fix to convert the offline indicator banner from an overlay into a dedicated layout space that dynamically pushes all top-level website content, navbars, sidebars, and login views downward without obscuring or overlapping any UI elements._

---

### User Input

```
the offline banner for this project@[c:\Users\gsmur\Documents\GitHub\[oU1TS]\b1t-Sched\js\offline-indicator.js:L39-L60] shows as overlay and hides some website contents at the top. Make it have dedicated space so when offline, the banner pushes the website content down and all the website content is shown as intended.
```

---

### AI Thought

1. **Analyze User Issue & Root Cause**:
   - **Target Component**: `#offline-indicator` ("You're offline. Showing cached content.") defined in `js/offline-indicator.js` and styled in `css/components.css`.
   - **Problem**: When the browser goes offline, the offline banner was styled with `position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 10001;`. Because it acted as a floating overlay with hardcoded height assumptions in CSS (`top: 44px` / `30px` for navbar and `margin-top: 44px` / `30px` for `.main-content`), it had multiple flaws:
     1. On the unauthenticated Login/Auth screen (`#navbar` hidden), the login container had negative top margins pulling it behind the banner, obscuring the logo and header text.
     2. On mobile/compact screens, responsive text wrapping caused the banner height to exceed the hardcoded 30px offset (reaching 48px–60px), causing the banner to clip and overlap the top half of the navbar, logo, title, and buttons.
     3. Opening sidebar drawers (`.events-sidebar`, `.notice-sidebar`, `.classroom-sidebar`) or the mobile nav menu while offline resulted in their top headers and close controls being clipped behind the fixed banner.
     4. Desktop sticky sidebar (`.dashboard-sidebar`) was not dynamically offset, causing misalignment when offline.

2. **Formulate Solution Strategy**:
   - **Dynamic Height via CSS Custom Property (`--offline-banner-height`)**:
     - Manage a root CSS variable `--offline-banner-height: 0px;`.
     - In `js/offline-indicator.js`:
       - Measure the rendered height (`offsetHeight`) of `#offline-indicator` whenever it is shown.
       - Set `--offline-banner-height` dynamically on `document.documentElement`.
       - Implement a `ResizeObserver` on `#offline-indicator` (with fallback window `resize` listener) to reactively recalculate height whenever text wraps or the viewport dimensions change.
       - Clean up listeners and reset `--offline-banner-height` to `0px` on `hideOfflineIndicator()`.
     - Ensure the `#offline-indicator` is prepended at the top of `<body>` rather than appended at the end.
   - **Dedicated Layout Offsets in CSS (`css/components.css`)**:
     - Configure `body.offline-active .navbar` to use `top: var(--offline-banner-height, 42px)`.
     - Update `body.offline-active .main-content` padding-top across desktop (`calc(80px + var(--offline-banner-height, 42px))`), tablet (`calc(66px + var(--offline-banner-height, 42px))`), and mobile (`calc(60px + var(--offline-banner-height, 34px))`).
     - Adjust mobile nav drawer `.nav-center` top offset to `calc(60px + var(--offline-banner-height, 34px))`.
     - Reset `.auth-container` and `.set-details-container` top margins (`margin-top: 0 !important; min-height: calc(100vh - var(--offline-banner-height, 42px));`) so login and onboarding forms are fully visible and push down smoothly.
     - Adjust `.dashboard-sidebar`, `.events-sidebar`, `.notice-sidebar`, and `.classroom-sidebar` `top` and `height` properties when `body.offline-active`.
   - **Smooth Transitions (`css/navbar.css`, `css/main.css`)**:
     - Added `transition: top var(--transition-fast, 0.2s ease);` to `.navbar`.
     - Added `transition: padding-top var(--transition-fast, 0.2s ease);` to `.main-content`.
   - **HTML Static Inclusion (`index.html`)**:
     - Inserted `#offline-indicator` with accessibility attributes (`role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`) at the top of `<body>`.
